title: Setup: a soldier on its own half, off the files a soldier starts on
rationale: b4 is on the soldiers' own rank and still no soldier can be there. Before it crosses the river a soldier moves only forward, so it stands on the file it started on, and Red's five soldiers start on a, c, e, g and i. The clause holds on a side's own half alone: it ends where the sideways step begins.
